purpose: Introduce an opposing thought in conversation.
keywords: This restaurant is small. But the food is delicious.
I want to go. But I do not have time.
It is raining. But the game is still on.
restrictions: This use begins a new thought; noun + でも has other meanings.
mistake: Do not insert conjunction でも directly between a verb stem and its ending.

segments.role: Introduce an opposing thought in conversation. Sentence. でも + contrasting sentence.
